rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Elder One 
"H..how could this be...Tunsen...Tunsen the Mighty..has fallen...What kind of foul sorcery...is this..."

Druidess 
"The Elder tree foresaw your downfall... May Wotan unleash the seven winds upon you!"

Counselor 
"The city of Sullonia is ours, Master!..."

Speaman
"Why such violence! What is it that your kind seek?"

Counselor 
"We can hear the sounds of giants echoing through the mountains to the north... They must be immense!"

Sorcerer 
"Master! Asteroth escaped in an infernal plane before he was killed. He lives on, somewhere..."

Asteroth 
"You are not my true master! I will rely on my own powers to survive... Now that I am free from the Clans trap, no one can stop my influence from spreading!"

Witch 
"Asteroth is out of control! How can we fight him! Flee!"

Bethrezen 
"You are not ready to rule yourself! Bow before me, untaught creature! I am your master..."

Asteroth 
"Yes, Master Bethrezen... Please forgive me! I feel your strength overpowers me!"

Bethrezen 
"Fear not! I control this beast! He will be punished for his actions..."

Arch-Devil 
"We have secured the northern border master! The lands are ours!"

Anti-Paladin 
"The giants have found a passage through the mountains! Beware Master, they will attack us!"

Duke 
"The Mountain Clans have reinforcements coming from the north! Beware, they have sent the great hero Grunnen - he who fought in the First Great Wars a decade ago!"
Counselor"Beware master, many scouts have disappeared here! Something must have prevented their returning to us, Undead creatures probably... Advance with caution..."

Duke 
"Master! Giants have been seen approaching from the south!"

Bethrezen 
"We must reinforce our position on these territories... Set your demons upon the lands!"

Asteroth 
"Cohorts! We must capture the cities Sullonia, Tunnsen's Hall and Mallorin in order to control these lands. Forward!"

Possessed 
"Master, the alliance have sent a messenger to meet us!"

Venerable Warrior 
"You will pay for your crimes, Demons! We have assembled a force which you can never hope to beat! Return to the fires which you sprang from..."

Asteroth 
"Ha ha ha! Toy not with us, half-men! We will do no such thing... You stand between us and our goals! Bow or perish..."

Duke 
"Beware, Master! The Highfather is helping the Empire! A mighty light was seen near their capital..."

Onyx Gargoyle 
"I come to you on Bethrezen's behalf..."

Asteroth 
"What is this?! What are you saying? Bethrezen is presently among us!"

Onyx Gargoyle 
"Bethrezen forbids these actions! You must cease now..."

Bethrezen 
"We are losing precious time, cohorts! Attack this traitor... "

Asteroth 
"Yes, Master! He will be destroyed!"

Onyx Gargoyle 
"You will pay for your treachery... By Bethrezen I swear it!"

Venerable Warrior 
"Why do you persist in your attempts to defeat us? Our allied forces will not be vanquished..."

Bethrezen 
"Your flesh shall burn in our eternal fires before long, mortal..."

Venerable Warrior 
"We may be flesh and blood, but we shall banish you from this mortal realm..."

Bethrezen 
"How can you hope to stop me? You are already dead..."

Counselor 
"The King of the giants has been vanquished, Master! Our wrath will be feared by the giants henceforth!"

Counselor 
"Still the Undead... They are everywhere! What do they want from us? What does their wretched Goddess Mortis seek?"

Nightmare 
"Give usss the boy! Mortisss has sent usss to claim himmm..."

Demonologist 
"The boy! What do the undead want with him. You have been pursuing all of this time to gain our leader? This is folly, for he could never be vanquished by the likes of you..."

Nightmare 
"We have need of thhe boy, that issss sufficient! Now! Are you prepared to fight for his liffffe, or will you ssssave yoursssselves?!"

Bethrezen 
"Press on, Demons! Our forces grow weary of these petty skirmishes... Destroy them all in one fell swoop!"

Occultist 
"Do you not learn, beasts? Your evil blood shall be spilled on these battlefields!"

Occultist 
"You have evaded us long enough demon- boy... We will not rest until we find you!"

Asteroth 
"Before you touch Bethrezen you will have to deal with me..."

Occultist 
"Your turn will come... Our master will destroy you all!"
